Markets.title: Anthropic's $81 billion IPO overtakes Elon Musk's SpaceX to become the world's largest issue
Markets.summary: Anthropic has raised $81.3 billion in its initial public offering at $83 per share, surpassing SpaceX for the largest IPO in history. The Claude maker is valued at $1.5 trillion ahead of its Nasdaq debut.

Markets.title: Lagarde: Might consider role at WEF after ECB exit
Markets.summary: ECB President Christine Lagarde stated she might consider a leadership role at the World Economic Forum after her term ends. She clarified that she remains fully dedicated to her current position until she steps down on February 7.

Markets.title: US dollar hovers near 19-month high, Aussie falls after soft jobs data
Markets.summary: The US dollar hovered near a 19-month high following hawkish Federal Reserve comments, while the Australian dollar dropped to a ten-month low due to weak employment data. Meanwhile, bond yields declined after a successful 20-year auction and falling oil prices helped ease inflation concerns.

Markets.title: Sensex Today | Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: GIFT Nifty signals a negative start; Asian shares trade mixed
Markets.summary: Indian stock market indices, the Sensex and Nifty 50, are poised for a negative opening as indicated by GIFT Nifty futures. Meanwhile, Asian markets are trading with mixed results.

Markets.title: Gold recovers from one-year low as markets assess Fed rate outlook
Markets.summary: Gold prices rose 0.6% after dropping to a 14-month low due to investor anxiety and Federal Reserve interest rate scrutiny. Markets currently price in a 90% chance of a 25-basis-point Fed rate increase in December.

Geo-Political.title: Inside the old gas pipeline where Ukraine is fighting an underground war with Russia
Geo-Political.summary: BBC journalist Jonathan Beale accompanied Ukrainian forces fighting Russian troops inside an old underground gas pipeline. This subterranean tactic allows Ukrainian soldiers to battle away from the detection of Russian drones.

Geo-Political.title: 'The drones don't fly here' - BBC reports from Ukraine's new front line
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian forces are fighting Russian troops inside an old Soviet tunnel in the Kharkiv region. The BBC reported from this new front line where underground conditions prevent drones from flying.

Geo-Political.title: Myanmar faces historic genocide verdict at UN court over Rohingya massacres
Geo-Political.summary: Myanmar is facing a historic UN court trial over allegations of committing genocide against the Rohingya minority. No state has ever been found guilty of genocide by an international court.

Geo-Political.title: AI giant Anthropic valued at up to $1.5tn ahead of stock market debut
Geo-Political.summary: Five-year-old artificial intelligence company Anthropic is preparing for a stock market debut with a valuation of up to $1.5 trillion. This milestone makes the firm one of the largest and most valuable names in the technology sector.

Geo-Political.title: Van Gogh painting sells for record $190.4m after row over its Nazi history
Geo-Political.summary: Vincent van Gogh's 1890 painting *Châtaigniers en fleurs* sold for a record $190.4 million following a dispute regarding its Nazi-era provenance. The artwork was created during the final two months of the artist's life.

Geo-Political.title: Crimean Bridge attacked again, Russian official says
Geo-Political.summary: Traffic on the Crimean Bridge was suspended following another attack on the strategic link between Russia and the occupied territory. The head of Crimea confirmed the incident, marking a new strike on the Russian-controlled bridge.

Data & Insights.summary: The Mint economic tracker reveals warning signals flashing across various sectors of the Indian economy in October. However, producer and industrial segments are currently holding their ground despite fading benefits from past GST and interest rate cuts.

Data & Insights.title: UK inflation hits one-year high of 3.6%: Why are markets less convinced of another rate hike? | Explained
Data & Insights.summary: UK inflation rose to a one-year high of 3.6% in October due to increased fuel prices and tobacco taxes. Despite this increase, steady core and services inflation reduced market expectations for a December Bank of England rate hike.

Data & Insights.title: Trump, Xi, Putin unite $1.48 Trillion military might at Shenzhen: Will nukes be on the table? Why it matters
Data & Insights.summary: US President Donald Trump has arrived in Shenzhen, China, to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. On Thursday, he is scheduled to hold a high-stakes meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

Data & Insights.title: Soybean oil's share rises in India's edible oil import mix
Data & Insights.summary: In the 2025-26 period, India imported 5.83 million tonnes of soybean oil. This contributed to a total edible oil import volume of 16.92 million tonnes.

Data & Insights.title: Could AI boom trigger a jobs crisis? The risks Fed Chair Kevin Warsh sees beyond productivity gains
Data & Insights.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh warns that the AI boom could drive economic growth, displace widespread jobs through automation, or trigger an economic slowdown. These risks depend on whether AI investments and market expectations successfully deliver promised returns.

Data & Insights.title: Union Budget 2027-28: FICCI seeks graded LTCG taxation,  ₹100 lakh crore in credit for manufacturing growth
Data & Insights.summary: FICCI recommended restoring the long-term capital gains tax exemption on listed securities ahead of the Union Budget 2027-28. The industry body also proposed a calibrated increase in the securities transaction tax alongside measures to boost manufacturing credit.

India.title: UP BJP Leader's Son Dies As Bulldozer Hits Him During Akhilesh Yadav's Rally
India.summary: The son of a local BJP leader in Uttar Pradesh died after being struck by a bulldozer. The bulldozer was being used to shower flower petals on a political rally held by Akhilesh Yadav.

India.title: 18 Maharashtra Eateries Lose Licence Over Food Safety Violations
India.summary: Inspectors in Maharashtra revoked the licenses of 18 eateries due to severe food safety violations. The inspections revealed unhygienic preparation areas, improper food storage, pest infestations, and missing mandatory certificates.

India.title: Punjab National Bank Approves 8,254 Vacancies For Promotion, Direct Recruitment
India.summary: Punjab National Bank has approved 8,254 vacancies for promotions and direct recruitment. The openings consist of 4,380 positions in the Junior Management Grade Scale-I and 3,874 roles in the clerical cadre.

India.title: Gujarat Man Killed As Speeding Fortuner Loaded With Liquor Crashes Into Bike
India.summary: A speeding Toyota Fortuner carrying illegal foreign liquor and beer crashed into a motorcycle in Gujarat, killing the rider. The collision drew a large crowd that quickly gathered at the scene to accuse the SUV driver of smuggling alcohol.

India.title: Ahmedabad Police Detain Over 950 Suspected Drug Users In Stadium Crackdown
India.summary: Ahmedabad police detained over 950 suspected drug users during a crackdown at a stadium. Crime Branch Joint Commissioner Sharad Singhal stated the operation was intended to convey a clear message of zero tolerance.

India.title: Gujarat Cop Arrested For Accepting Rs 20,000 Bribe To Return Seized Phone
India.summary: A Gujarat police officer named Ekta Pandya was arrested for accepting a 20,000 rupee bribe. She had demanded the money to return a mobile phone that she seized during a prohibition case investigation.

General.title: McDonald's sex abuse: 'They were waiting for the younger girls to turn 18'
General.summary: A former McDonald's worker has called on the company to reform its treatment of younger employees after a judge ruled that a legal case regarding sexual abuse can proceed. The lawsuit alleges that management knowingly waited for underage staff members to turn 18 before targeting them.

General.title: 'Feudal' leasehold system set to be scrapped in England and Wales
